evidence.reason: The current tip already normalizes both changed paths and recursively discovered test paths to POSIX before selection: changed paths use `toPosix(relative(process.cwd(), resolve(file)))`, and discovered paths use `toPosix(String(file))` before `${dir}/` prefixing and `isTest`/`selectRelatedTests`.
